subject: mathematics
concept: Real-world word problems modeled by linear functions and systems, using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore Model Method (bar modeling) principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student translates a realistic scenario (cost comparison, distance over time) into a linear equation or system
exercise.pictorial: Student graphs the scenario before interpreting the solution
exercise.abstract: Student solves a real-world linear function or system word problem and explains their reasoning

misconception_flags: sets up the equation correctly but misinterprets what the final answer means in context

interest_binding: word problems generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
